en: Two-sided vintage postcard. The front shows a black‑and‑white photograph of a large, multi‑storey collegiate building with inner courtyards and a formal garden featuring paths and a circular flower bed in the foreground. Hills and other city buildings are visible in the background. Below the image there is Hungarian text describing the Maurinum at Erzsébet University and listing accommodation fees. The reverse side is a typical divided‑back layout with address lines and stamp box, printed in Hungarian, and a caption describing the southern façade of the Pécs University Saint Maur College with garden and sports field.
